faq.headline: Nonprofit Website FAQs
faq.description: Clear answers to help you plan and publish your nonprofit site.

items.question: Can we collect donations through the site?
items.answer: Describe how to support your organisation, but only enable on-site donations after a suitable payment provider and flow are configured.

items.question: Can people volunteer through a form?
items.answer: A form can collect initial interest; your team can handle screening and placement.

items.question: Can we show impact figures?
items.answer: Yes, when figures are accurate, dated, and backed by your records.

items.question: How can I explain our programs and mission?
items.answer: Describe whom each program serves, what it does, and how people can get involved. Keep claims specific and supported by your organisation’s records.

items.question: Can supporters donate directly through the website?
items.answer: Only when a suitable payment provider and donation flow are configured. Otherwise, explain how to support your work and link to an established donation channel.

items.question: Can volunteers apply through a form?
items.answer: A form can collect initial interest and preferred volunteer roles. Your team should manage screening, placement, and any sensitive information through its own process.
